answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence earned by an ember of brief activity fades unless honest service is sustained over time. In the EigenTrust matrix, freshly spawned sybil identities have near-zero eigenvector centrality: without reciprocal, trusted paths from established peers, they gain negligible aggregate weight and cannot meet consensus thresholds. An orchard of colluding accounts cannot amplify itself; jade endorsements are discounted without credible transitive support.
